config.rules.design_hint: For homepage rules, this design system is injected after task rules.
config.rules.select_hint: Select a rule or create a new one.
config.rules.disabled_hint: Automatic task-rule injection is disabled in config.yaml.
config.rules.editor_hint: Rules are Markdown guardrails injected before matching tasks begin.
config.rules.confirm_restore: Restore the built-in version of rule {id}?
config.rules.rule_id_help: Short unique name of the rule, for example homepage. It cannot be changed after creation.
config.rules.rule_title_help: Readable name shown in the rule library.
config.rules.priority_help: When several rules match, higher numbers are injected first. Default 50.
config.rules.enabled_help: Switched-off rules are never injected into tasks.
config.rules.tools_help: Tool names that activate this rule, separated by commas. Pick a tool below to add it.
config.rules.workflows_help: Workflow names that activate this rule, separated by commas. Pick a workflow below to add it.
config.rules.keywords_help: Words in the task text that activate this rule, separated by commas.
config.rules.body_help: The guardrail text in Markdown. It is injected before a matching task begins.
